title: Ant
intro: Weights, fitness, Muay Thai, boxing, kickboxing — all under one roof, held together by one idea.

items.text: Ant is a gym with five disciplines under one roof. On paper that's a list of services — but people stay here because of the room, not the schedule. One ant is small; a colony moves what's bigger than itself. A fighter knows this: you step into the ring alone, but it's the gym that got you there.
What holds it together isn't the schedule. Most gyms sell a personal result — your body, your progress, you against yourself. People stay at **ANT** because of the room they train in.
The name carries the idea. One ant is small; a colony moves what's far bigger than itself. Any fighter knows this version of it — you step into the ring alone, but it's the gym that got you there.
Three letters, one body: A, N and T built into the shape of a single ant. The whole idea in one move — separate parts becoming one organism.
Red on black — the colors of the ring. They don't calm you down, and they're not supposed to.
The ant lives everywhere the colony gathers: the ring floor, the gloves, the Fight Night wall, the member cards. Every card has its own number — one of many.
Five disciplines under one roof, and it reads as one place. What ties it together is simple: everyone here belongs to the same colony. The mark just says it out loud.
